final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_count, AVG(sr.avg_rate - o.avg_rate) AS average_excess FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.avg_rate > o.avg_rate
